Energy reconciliation: Slurm against DCGM

Slurm's energy for the partner's accounts (sacct ConsumedEnergyRaw, which reflects a job's real energy only for an exclusive allocation) against the IT energy the gateway attributed from the DCGM counters. The difference is DCGM minus Slurm, in kWh and as a percentage of Slurm's figure.

A job's energy is attributed to the period in proportion to the share of its run inside it, assuming constant power.

Slurm file: 12 jobs, jobs from 2026-09-30 12:00 to 2026-11-02 08:00 UTC; 11 used (2 only partly inside the period, prorated), 1 outside the period, 0 still running; 14 job steps, 0 without energy and 0 never started left out.

Budget against actual

Variance is actual minus budgeted (positive: over budget) and as a percentage of the budgeted amount; Budgeted is the declared budgets prorated to the month (a team budget over the organisation's), Estimated the weekly profile allowances of the partner's people. Amounts are in minor units rounded once, half to even; units are never added. A row is flagged beyond 15 % (variance_threshold_pct; FinOps Foundation, Budgeting: 20 % Crawl, 15 % Walk, 12 % Run).
